# Harvard University

> > Harvard University: America's oldest institution of higher education, comprising Harvard College, 12 graduate and professional schools, and the Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study.

Harvard offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs across disciplines including medicine, law, business, education, public health, engineering, design, and divinity. The university advances research in life sciences, neuroscience, public policy, and healthcare while maintaining a significant endowment supporting financial aid and climate initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Harvard College
- Harvard Medical School
- Harvard Graduate School of Education
- Harvard Kennedy School
- Harvard Business School
- Harvard Law School
- Harvard Kenneth C. Griffin Graduate School of Arts and Sciences
- Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
- Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences
- Graduate programs and PhD studies
- Life sciences and neuroscience research
- Financial aid and endowment
- Healthcare quality and patient safety
- Urban planning and design
- Educational leadership

## Academic Programs

- [Life Sciences - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/programs/life-sciences): PhD programs in life sciences through Harvard GSAS and integrated studies
- [Neuroscience - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/programs/neuroscience): Undergraduate and PhD neuroscience programs at Harvard College and GSAS
- [Healthcare Quality and Safety - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/programs/healthcare-quality-and-safety): Harvard Medical School MS in healthcare quality and patient safety online
- [Urban Planning and Design - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/programs/urban-planning-and-design): Graduate School of Design M.A.U.D. and urban planning master's programs
- [Human Development and Education - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/programs/human-development-and-education): Harvard Graduate School of Education Ed.M. in human development
- [Industrial-Organizational Psychology - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/programs/industrial-organizational-psychology): Master's program in workplace psychology through Continuing Education
- [Dental Education - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/programs/dental-education): Harvard School of Dental Medicine MMSc and DMD specialty programs
- [Mechanical Engineering - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/programs/mechanical-engineering): Undergraduate BS in mechanical engineering at Harvard SEAS

## About Harvard

- [Endowment - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/about/endowment): Harvard's endowment supporting research, climate solutions, and aid
- [Board of Overseers - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/about/leadership-and-governance/board-of-overseers): Alumni-led Board of Overseers governance and leadership structure
- [Athletics - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/campus/athletics): Harvard sports programs, recreation, intramurals, and Olympic athletes

## Research and Insights

- [The Pandemic Years - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/in-focus/the-pandemic-years): COVID-19 research, vaccine development by Kizzmekia Corbett, and equity
- [Water - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/in-focus/water): Water access, contamination, PFAS research, and environmental justice
- [Early Development - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/in-focus/early-development): Child development, brain research, and early literacy by Harvard experts
- [Healthy living - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/in-focus/healthy-living): Harvard experts on nutrition, exercise, mental health, and wellbeing
- [Black History Month - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/in-focus/black-history-month): Black Women Oral History Project and African American heritage resources

## Optional

- [Celebrating the Class of 2023 - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/in-focus/celebrating-the-class-of-2023): 372nd Commencement coverage featuring Tom Hanks and Class of 2023
- [Games - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/in-focus/games): Harvard experts explore gaming, puzzles, esports, and skill development
- [Harvard Public Affairs and Communications - Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu/public-affairs-and-communications): Media relations, press office, and community affairs contact directory
